# ripwire --arch rules file for the vibe-check ripwireadapter fixture captures.
#
# Grammar (bundled ripwire 0.6.9, skills/ripwire-layers/SKILL.md):
#   layer NAME = substr    assign files whose ROOT-RELATIVE path contains substr
#   deny FROM -> TO        forbid dependency edges from layer FROM to layer TO
#   allow FROM -> TO       permit an otherwise-denied edge
#   #                      comment
#
# This file defines layers only, with no deny rules: the fixture captures want
# the Martin Ca/Ce/I <metrics> table that --arch emits, not enforcement, so no
# rule can fire a violation (--arch exits 2 on a violation; these captures
# expect exit 0). Layer substrings match root-relative paths, so the file means
# the same thing in every checkout. Both fixtures' cycle directories are
# covered: Python spells them cycle_a/cycle_b, TypeScript cycle-a/cycle-b.
layer models = models
layer python_cycle_a = cycle_a
layer python_cycle_b = cycle_b
layer ts_cycle_a = cycle-a
layer ts_cycle_b = cycle-b
